new_scholarship.description: The Embassy of France in South Africa invites citizens of South Africa, Lesotho and Malawi to apply for Master's or PhD study at French higher education institutions in 2027/28 under the France Excellence scheme. Beneficiaries receive a monthly living allowance, one return economy-class airfare, social security and health insurance, priority student accommodation and exemptions from the visa fee and the Student and Campus Life Contribution (CVEC). Tuition fees are not covered. Because of the opposing hemispheres' academic calendars, laureates follow online French-language courses through the Alliances Francaises network in South Africa from February to July 2027 before departing for France in September 2027.

new_scholarship.description: The Institut Pasteur runs the Pasteur-Paris University international doctoral programme with Universite Paris Cite, Sorbonne Universite and Universite Paris Saclay for candidates holding a Master's degree or equivalent in life or medical sciences. Selected students are employees of the Institut Pasteur on a three-year working contract and receive a monthly salary of EUR 2,000 including social benefits, a EUR 4,000 welcome bonus, annual round-trip travel reimbursement and EUR 750 per year for conferences. The 2027 call for October 2027 enrolment is open from 1 October to 16 November 2026, with around 15 places offered each year through a three-stage selection ending in an interview week at Institut Pasteur.

Candidates must not have resided in France for more than 12 months in the three years before the deadline. No age or nationality restriction.

new_scholarship.description: The Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at Sciences Po is the first such programme in continental Europe and supports students from the African continent who wish to pursue a two-year Master's degree at Sciences Po, covering the full financial needs of selected Scholars. Applicants must first be declared eligible and receive an application fee waiver, then apply and be admitted through the International Graduate Admissions Procedure, and finally be selected by the Programme's Selection Committee. For the 2027 intake the fee-waiver window runs from October to mid-December 2026, while the scholarship application timeline itself had not been published on the page as of 4 October 2026. Shortlisted admitted candidates are invited to a roughly 25-minute online interview conducted by Zoom.

new_scholarship.description: The Ramanujan Fellowship, operated by the Anusandhan National Research Foundation, is a reverse brain drain scheme that brings brilliant Indian and Indian-origin scientists and engineers from abroad to take up scientific research positions in India. It is scientist-specific and highly selective, restricted to candidates below 40 years of age who hold a higher degree such as a PhD in science or engineering, a master's in engineering or technology, or an MD, with adequate professional experience and a proven track record evidenced by publications and recognition.
